nodes.name: update_capital
nodes.summary: Fetches capital data via AJAX and updates the capital timestamp indicator, colour-coding it by staleness.

nodes.name: update_costs
nodes.summary: Retrieves trading cost data and rebuilds the costs summary and detail tables in the dashboard.

nodes.name: update_forex
nodes.summary: Fetches FX balance data and populates the forex table on the dashboard.

nodes.name: update_liquidity
nodes.summary: Loads instrument liquidity metrics and renders them with formatted risk values into the liquidity table.

nodes.name: update_pandl
nodes.summary: Fetches profit-and-loss data and populates per-instrument, per-strategy, and per-asset-class P&L tables.

nodes.name: update_processes
nodes.summary: Refreshes the process-monitoring panel, rendering process status, config, and price-update freshness with staleness-based colour coding.

nodes.name: update_reconcile
nodes.summary: Loads reconciliation data and builds strategy, contract, and broker position-break tables, flagging breaks and gateway status.

nodes.name: update_risk
nodes.summary: Fetches risk data and renders the correlation matrix plus detailed per-instrument risk metrics into dashboard tables.

nodes.name: update_rolls
nodes.summary: Loads contract roll status and details, rendering roll tables and colour-coding the roll status indicator.

nodes.name: update_strategy
nodes.summary: Fetches per-strategy summary data and populates the strategy table on the dashboard.

nodes.name: update_trades
nodes.summary: Loads trade execution data and builds overview, delay, and slippage tables with formatted execution-quality metrics.

nodes.name: roll_post
nodes.summary: Posts a roll action for an instrument to the backend, rendering returned price tables and updating the roll UI state machine.

nodes.name: package_files
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a directory collecting relative paths of files matching a given extension, used to include data files in the package.
